{{Short description|Ranking of German professional football clubs}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=June 2020}}
The '''All-time Bundesliga table''' ({{langx|de|link=no|Ewige Tabelle der Bundesliga}}) is a ranking of all German football clubs based on their performance in the [[Bundesliga]], the top division of German football. In this ranking 3 points are awarded for a win, 1 for a draw, and 0 for a loss, although the Bundesliga awarded 2 points for a win until the [[1994–95 Bundesliga|1994–95]] season.<ref>{{cite web | title = Ewige Tabelle | access-date = 4 July 2008 |year = 2008 | publisher = Deutscher Fußball Bund | url = https://www.dfb.de/index.php?id=82907 | language = de| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20080531132107/https://www.dfb.de/index.php?id=82907| archive-date= 31 May 2008 | url-status= live}}</ref>

In the [[1983–84 Bundesliga|1983–84]] season, [[FC Bayern Munich|Bayern Munich]] took the lead from [[1. FC Köln]], which had led the standings since the inception of the Bundesliga in 1963. The ranking includes the 58 teams which have played in the Bundesliga since its inception (in the [[2026–27 Bundesliga|2026–27]] season, [[Elversberg]] joined the Bundesliga to become the league's 59th team). [[Hamburger SV]] was the last club to have participated in all seasons, but they were relegated after the [[2017–18 Bundesliga|2017–18]] season.

Clubs highlighted in blue and green play in the Bundesliga in the [[2025–26 Bundesliga|2025–26]] season, which marks the 63rd season since inception. Clubs highlighted in yellow were members of the inaugural [[1963–64 Bundesliga]] which do not currently play in the Bundesliga.

This list is current as of 16 May 2026, after the [[2025–26 Bundesliga|2025–26]] season.<ref>[http://www.fussballdaten.de/bundesliga/ewigetabelle/ Die Ewige Tabelle] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130517193314/http://www.fussballdaten.de/bundesliga/ewigetabelle/ |date=17 May 2013 }} {{in lang|de}} [[Fussballdaten.de]]. Retrieved 18 May 2019</ref><ref>[http://www.weltfussball.de/ewige_tabelle/bundesliga/ Bundesliga .:.
